detail.output: WeatherFlow iOS app completed. Implemented real Open-Meteo forecast/geocoding data, CoreLocation, animated weather backgrounds, current conditions, hourly and multi-day forecasts, city search and refresh. Verification: unsigned iOS build succeeded; signed physical-device build succeeded; app installed on physical iPhone 15 Pro Max; bundle com.cornel.deleteweather launched successfully; WeatherFlow process confirmed running on device. PR: https://github.com/saurikCornel/delete-weather/pull/1
